pages.exact_request_text:
Draw a THROWAWAY DIRECTOR THUMBNAIL BOARD with exactly 12 panels in four columns and three rows on white paper. Each panel is a portrait 9:16 rectangle. This must look like a hurried classroom whiteboard diagram made in 30 seconds per panel with a thin black marker. Extremely few lines: approximately 10 to 20 bare contour lines in each panel. All white interiors. Human figures have EMPTY oval heads, simple box or trapezoid torsos, broad outlined bent limbs. NO eyes, noses, realistic faces, hair, beards, clothing folds, detailed hats, texture, lighting, shading, shadows, hatching, stippling, grey fills, perspective rendering or finished illustration. Do not draw stick figures or ChronoStick mascots: bodies have broad outlined volumes. Generic anonymous humans only. Props and settings are simple geometric outline placeholders, not designed assets. Use at most TWO background outline strokes unless a setting is the whole subject. No dramatic cinematography styling. Small shot IDs above the panels are the only text. All twelve IDs must appear in order. The modern mask PROP can have two eye holes, one curved moustache line and one short chin mark; these are its only facial marks. Keep period people unmasked and faceless. Do not turn this into a detailed pencil comic. Think crude wireframe blocking diagram. The intentional absence of final design is essential.

Panel 1, exact ID S01: ECU modern mask. An isolated mask tilts slightly in a human hand; distinctive moustache/goatee are prop cues.
Panel 2, exact ID S02: CU hand and mask edge. One plain hand lifts the mask into the center; no person wearing it in 1605.
Panel 3, exact ID S03: CU mask eye opening. The mask eye opening dominates; a static graphic curiosity insert.
Panel 4, exact ID S04: Wide historic Westminster. Two low rectangular blocks with simple pitched gable roofs beside one horizontal river line. Absolutely no clock tower, Gothic spires or current Palace of Westminster.
Panel 5, exact ID S05: Medium stone entrance. An empty period palace entrance fills the frame; one closed wooden door.
Panel 6, exact ID S06: Tight dark palace window. A candle glow inside a period window; contrast signals the historical night.
Panel 7, exact ID S07: Medium three conspirators. Exactly three simple adult human silhouettes around one table; the focal man is Fawkes.
Panel 8, exact ID S08: CU pendant. One hand rests near a small cross pendant on a conspirator chest; no writing.
Panel 9, exact ID S09: CU crown prop. A simple crown silhouette sits on a plain target-plan page; symbol of the monarch, not a named royal portrait.
Panel 10, exact ID S10: Over-shoulder table plan. One faceless outlined person points at a page with two low rectangles and triangular gable roofs. No clock tower, Gothic spires or lettering.
Panel 11, exact ID S11: CU Fawkes reaction. Close framing of an EMPTY oval head and upper shoulders turning toward the table. No facial details.
Panel 12, exact ID S12: Medium decision. Three silhouettes lean toward the table; exactly one lead pointing gesture, others still.
